Principais responsabilidades * Gestão da agenda executiva: Planejamento, organização e acompanhamento dos compromissos do diretor, incluindo reuniões, agendamentos, prazos e atividades prioritárias. * Gestão de prioridades e demandas: Organização, monitoramento e acompanhamento das solicitações direcionadas à diretoria, assegurando o cumprimento de prazos e a continuidade das atividades. * Comunicação executiva: Gerenciamento de chamadas telefônicas, mensagens, correspondências e demais canais de comunicação, realizando a triagem e o direcionamento das demandas. * Gestão documental: Organização, controle, atualização e arquivamento de documentos físicos e digitais, garantindo integridade, acessibilidade e segurança das informações. * Assuntos estratégicos e confidenciais: Apoio no tratamento de informações sensíveis e demandas reservadas do diretor, mantendo elevados padrões de ética, discrição e sigilo profissional. * Recepção institucional: Atendimento e recepção de visitantes, parceiros comerciais e prestadores de serviços no escritório, assegurando cordialidade e postura profissional. * Gestão de sistemas internos: Registro, atualização, conferência e organização de informações em plataformas e sistemas próprios da empresa. * Otimização de processos com tecnologia: Utilização de ferramentas digitais, automações e soluções de inteligência artificial para aprimorar a organização, agilizar tarefas administrativas e aumentar a produtividade da rotina executiva. * Suporte administrativo personalizado: Apoio às necessidades operacionais e administrativas do diretor, antecipando demandas e contribuindo para a eficiência de sua rotina profissional. Diferenciais * Experiência no assessoramento direto a empresários, diretores ou executivos. * Conhecimento de ferramentas de automação, organização de tarefas e gestão de projetos. * Experiência prática na utilização de inteligência artificial para elaboração de documentos, organização de informações, pesquisas e otimização de atividades administrativas. * Conhecimento de inglês e/ou espanhol. * Experiência em ambientes corporativos dinâmicos. Perfil que buscamos Buscamos uma profissional de confiança, organizada, resolutiva e tecnologicamente atualizada, que combine postura executiva, discrição e capacidade de antecipar necessidades. Valorizamos profissionais que tenham iniciativa para propor melhorias, facilidade para incorporar novas tecnologias e habilidade para transformar demandas em soluções práticas. Nosso objetivo é contar com uma profissional que contribua diretamente para a produtividade, organização e eficiência da Diretoria Executiva.

We do so by creating and documenting stories and experiences that matter to Singaporeans. And to have Fun. We’re committed to creating the right conditions for our colleagues to thrive and to providing the leadership and guidance necessary for our teammates to experience professional advancement and personal growth. The Role As an Assistant Editor, you will work as part of Mothership’s Current Affairs team to ensure and improve the quality, accuracy, and timeliness of our news and current affairs reporting across multiple media formats. You will lead and mentor a team of writers and content creators and be responsible for executing, assigning, and coordinating editorial tasks and duties. A snippet of what you can expect to be doing on a day-to-day basis: Managing the daily output of news content on our website and social media platforms through the effective editing, assigning, and curation of stories Identifying important news developments in Singapore or that affect Singapore Participating in news gathering, reporting, and story development Leading and mentoring a team of writers and content creators Assigning and editing stories by your team of writers and content creators Independently managing project timelines and resources Identifying potential editorial opportunities and engaging and building relationships with stakeholders Working with other editors to ensure our content is accurate, balanced, and timely Requirements We are looking for someone with a minimum of four years of operational experience in news, digital media, or a related industry and with experience in managing teams and projects. Bonus points if you can provide samples of past writing works along with your resume or even a short self-recorded video on why we should hire you. Only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

review_candidates.description: Grow Your Career at Brant Community Healthcare System (BCHS) At BCHS, we are driven by a bold vision: To Lead Beyond Care. As a two-site community hospital system in Brantford and Paris, Ontario, we serve with purpose, passion, and a deep commitment to the people who rely on us. Brantford General Hospital – Our acute care hospital offering a full spectrum of inpatient and outpatient services. The Willett in Paris – Home to our urgent care centre and transitional care services, supporting patients through every step of their healthcare journey. With Over 130 Years Of Service, BCHS Is Evolving With a Renewed Focus On Excellence, Collaboration, And Innovation. Our Strategic Priorities Center On Quality Care, Connected Teams, And a Healthy Future For Our Patients, Our People, And Our Community. Our Culture Is Shaped By Our Core Values And Pillars Core Values: Be Bold and Courageous | Commit to Excellence | Champion Equity | Be Trustworthy Four Pillars: Patient-First | People-Centred | Partnership-Based | Progress-Focused These values reflect who we are, what we stand for, and how we work together to have influence. Join us in shaping the future of healthcare—right here at BCHS. Why Choose BCHS? Investing in You – Access to a centralized Education Fund, tuition support, and professional development opportunities. Flexible Scheduling – Within a standard work week Career Growth – Internal job postings, mentorship programs, and leadership development. Predictable Work Locations – Stability and consistency in your work environment. Collaborative Team Culture – Work alongside skilled professionals in a supportive, interdisciplinary setting. Employee Wellness Matters – Peer Support Team, Wellness Committee, Free, confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for employees and their families. Commitment to Safety – Comprehensive safety programs for all Competitive Compensation and Benefits –– Salaries and benefits designed to align with industry standards, reinforcing our commitment to attracting and retaining top talent. Excellent Pension Plan. Diversity & Inclusion – We are actively working to diversify our teams and remove systemic barriers in hiring, retention, and advancement. We track and report on our progress because representation matters. We regularly review our benefits, policies, and programs through an equity lens to meet the needs of our diverse teams. Provide accommodations for religious practices and use trauma-informed policies that support mental wellbeing. Recognition & Rewards – Employee appreciation programs and professional recognition opportunities and Corporate Committee Community Impact – Make a real difference in patient care and public health every day. Choose Civility – Where every interaction matters. Civility and respect shape our workplace, as individuals treat one another—and the communities we serve with dignity, empathy, and cultural awareness. We foster a culture of civility by raising awareness, setting clear expectations, and continually reviewing our policies and practices to ensure respect is at the core of everything we do. Position Summary An Anesthesia Assistant (AA) is a Registered Respiratory Therapist or a Registered Nurse who holds a Certified Clinical Anesthesia Assistant Certification from a Canadian Society of Respiratory Therapy (CSRT) accredited school. They work in collaboration and under the supervision of an Anesthesiologist to provide anesthesia care to patients undergoing surgical procedures. They are responsible for monitoring stable anesthetized patients under the direction of the Anesthesiologist as well as ensuring patient safety and comfort before, during, and after surgery. They will assist the Anesthesiologist in administering anesthesia, monitoring patients' vital signs, evaluate and monitor patients' cardiorespiratory conditions. The AA is a collaborative team member, working alongside the nursing team to meet the needs of the patients who are under the care of an anesthesiologist. Primary Responsibilities Assist in the patient's care during induction by administering prescribed anesthetic agents as directed by the Anesthesiologist and/or through medical directives, monitoring for side effects and treatment effectiveness, and assessing the patient’s physiological condition throughout the anesthesia process. Provide diagnostic data to the Anesthesiologist or Surgeon, including blood gases, pulse oximetry, transcutaneous monitoring, and end tidal Carbon Dioxide (CO2). Support the preparation of the patient for surgery by completing the pre-operative assessment, inserting necessary lines and tubes (such as intravenous, nasogastric and endotracheal), and ensuring proper patient positioning. Ensure appropriate performance and maintenance of anesthesia related equipment Assisting and monitoring patients in an anesthesia block room Mandatory Qualifications Advanced Diploma in Respiratory Therapy or an Undergraduate degree in Nursing plus a current certification as a Certified Clinical Anesthesia Assistant required Registered and in good standing with the College of Respiratory Therapists of Ontario or the College of Nurses of Ontario required Current Basic Cardiac Life Support (BCLS) certification required Current Advanced Cardiac Life Support (ACLS) certification preferred Current Paediatric Advanced Life Support (PALS) certification preferred Minimum 2 years current experience in the Anesthesia Assistant role in operating room required 3- 5 years’ experience as a Registered Respiratory Therapist or Registered Nurse in a Critical Care/Emergency department or Operating Room Strong organizational, time management, and interpersonal skills Ability to work independently and collaboratively across all levels of the organization Criminal Record Check required Safety (patient, worker & workplace) is a BCHS Corporate Priority. The successful applicant will demonstrate good stewardship in the identification, reporting and mitigation of unsafe acts or conditions. Our Commitment to Equity, Diversity, and Inclusion BCHS is committed to building an inclusive and accessible workplace that reflects the diversity of the communities we serve. We welcome people from all walks of life, including people of all genders, sexual orientations, racial and ethnic backgrounds, Indigenous identities, abilities, and lived experiences. Inclusion is part of how we deliver better care We are dedicated to removing barriers and providing accommodations at every stage of the hiring process in accordance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act (AODA). If you require any accommodations, please inform us when contacted, and we will work with you to meet your needs. Ready to Make a Difference? If you are passionate about healthcare and looking for a supportive and dynamic work environment, we would love to hear from you! Apply today and join BCHS in delivering exceptional care with compassion and integrity.

review_candidates.title: (Assistant) Service Manager, Power System Division
review_candidates.description: Job Overview: We are seeking an experienced and results-driven Assistant Service Manager to oversee the operation, maintenance planning, and lifecycle management of diesel generator systems supporting mission-critical data center operations. The role is responsible for leading service teams, coordinating preventive and corrective maintenance, optimizing resources, and ensuring compliance with OEM standards, regulatory requirements, and service level agreements (SLAs) to maximize equipment reliability, availability, and uptime. Acting as the key liaison between customers, field service engineers, subcontractors, and internal stakeholders, the successful candidate will drive operational excellence, enhance service delivery, and implement continuous improvement initiatives to support critical power operations. Key Responsibilities: 1. Service Operations and Maintenance Management Oversee the day-to-day operation, maintenance, reliability, and availability of diesel generator systems supporting mission-critical data center operations. Develop, implement, and maintain annual, quarterly, monthly, and weekly preventive and corrective maintenance plans in accordance with OEM recommendations, contractual requirements, regulatory standards, and service level agreements (SLAs). Plan and coordinate scheduled maintenance, equipment shutdowns, generator testing, load bank testing, synchronization testing, emergency response testing, major overhauls, and maintenance windows with customers and internal stakeholders. Ensure maintenance activities are executed safely, efficiently, and with minimal disruption to customer operations. 2. Maintenance Planning and Work Order Management Create, review, schedule, and manage maintenance work orders through the Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS). Ensure all maintenance activities, inspections, service reports, testing records, and maintenance histories are accurately documented and closed in a timely manner. Track outstanding maintenance actions and ensure prompt resolution while maintaining complete asset maintenance records. 3. Resource and Spare Parts Management Plan and optimize deployment of field service engineers, technicians, contractors, and OEM specialists to support preventive, corrective, and emergency maintenance activities. Coordinate the availability of tools, testing equipment, lifting equipment, and site resources required for maintenance execution. Forecast spare parts and consumables requirements based on maintenance schedules, equipment lifecycle, and reliability trends. Maintain optimal inventory levels for critical and long lead-time components while coordinating procurement and supplier performance to minimize service interruptions. Manage service budgets, optimize manpower and resource utilization, and implement cost-control initiatives without compromising service quality or equipment reliability. 4. Reliability, Compliance and Continuous Improvement Ensure all maintenance activities comply with customer requirements, contractual obligations, operational standards, environmental, health and safety (EHS) regulations, permit-to-work procedures, and site-specific safety requirements. Monitor equipment reliability and implement reliability-centered maintenance (RCM), predictive maintenance, and continuous improvement initiatives to maximize equipment uptime and operational performance. Participate in quality audits, operational reviews, and process improvement projects to strengthen maintenance planning, service delivery, and operational efficiency. Develop and maintain service procedures, maintenance standards, and best practices to support operational excellence. 5. Performance Monitoring and Technical Support Monitor, analyse, and continuously improve maintenance and service performance using key performance indicators (KPIs), including Preventive Maintenance (PM) Completion Rate, First-Time Fix Rate (FTFR), Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF), Mean Time to Repair (MTTR), Generator Availability, SLA Compliance, and Response Time. Analyse maintenance trends, recurring failures, and equipment performance to identify improvement opportunities. Lead troubleshooting of complex technical issues, major equipment failures, and emergency incidents while minimizing operational downtime. Conduct root cause analysis (RCA), implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA), and monitor effectiveness to prevent recurrence. Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual maintenance and performance reports for management and customers. 6. Leadership and Stakeholder Management Lead, coach, mentor, and supervise field service engineers, technicians, contractors, and service partners, fostering a culture of accountability, technical excellence, safety, and continuous improvement. Coordinate maintenance schedules, outages, and service activities with customers to minimize operational impact and ensure service excellence. Attend customer operational and maintenance review meetings, providing maintenance plans, service reports, testing results, and performance updates. Build strong working relationships with customers, internal departments, vendors, subcontractors, and OEM partners to ensure effective service delivery and contract compliance. Collaborate with engineering, procurement, finance, legal, and commercial teams to support service execution, contract delivery, and operational objectives. 7. Business Support and Service Development Support service proposals, contract scope development, tender submissions, and aftermarket business growth initiatives. Analyse customer feedback, service performance, industry trends, and market developments to identify opportunities for service innovation, operational excellence, and revenue growth. Contribute to strategic initiatives that enhance customer satisfaction, service capability, and long-term business competitiveness. Job Requirements: Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Power Generation Engineering, or a related discipline (Diploma holders with relevant experience may be considered); professional certifications are an advantage. Minimum 5–8 years of experience in diesel generator systems, critical power, data centers, maintenance planning, or service operations, with 2–3 years in a supervisory or team leadership role. Strong technical knowledge of diesel engines, alternators, generator control systems, fuel systems, and maintenance planning, with familiarity in CMMS/ERP systems, NFPA 110, ISO 8528, and data center operational standards. Demonstrated ability to manage maintenance planning, service budgets, manpower, spare parts, and operational resources to achieve high equipment reliability and cost efficiency. Strong leadership, planning, analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to respond effectively in a fast-paced, mission-critical environment. Proficient in Microsoft Office applications with excellent written and spoken English. Note: This position is primarily based in a site office environment
